7-4399-4518-8333.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-4399-4518-8333.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Hamza.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Sickbay trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sickbay trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
7-4399-4518-8333.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

116-2645-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4316-5078-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1350-2793-3899-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {1}{U}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-4247-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-4247-6578.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

13-4695-8089.description:
Activate Selenia by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

215-1849-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1849-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

876-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Ghoulcaller Gisa.
Repeat.

5540-7000-7512.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
An opponent controls an artifact.
If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
5540-7000-7512.description:
Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
Repeat from step 3.
5540-7000-7512.notes: Clarion Conqueror prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7330.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Mikey & Mona trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4968-6919-7315.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to High Score.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6919-7315.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-2494-3459-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Battered Golem to gain all creature types.
Activate Dwarven Bloodboiler by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the Dwarven Bloodboiler ability, giving target creature +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

804-5775-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-5775-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
804-5775-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Sakashima, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Sakashima. Choose to have Sakashima enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-3875-6975.notablePrerequisites: There are at least eight lands between the battlefield under your control and your hand, four or which enter untapped and can tap to produce at least {4}.
1401-3875-6975.description:
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding Multani to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
When the lands enter, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate at least four lands that enter untapped by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Multani's ability by paying {1}{G} and returning two lands to your hand.
Repeat step 4 at least once, and more times if desired.
Resolve all Multani abilities, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1401-3875-6975.notes: You can repeat step 4 to bounce other lands, but you must bounce lands in multiples of two. All lands bounced this way will be placed onto the battlefield again by Journey to the Oracle.

1402-2218-4763-6791.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4693-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4693-5231.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-4693-5231.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1062-1742-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-1742-3487-5674.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-2034-3263-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

777-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
777-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2043-4050-4094-6671.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

277-5413-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-5413-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2063-2656--84.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Mischievous Poltergeist abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

2511-2523-5558.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

372-1018-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

654-2800-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-2800-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-2800-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

914-1753-3335.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1753-3335.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-1753-3335.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

883-2452-3249-5670--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
883-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

539-2034-2907-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ashaya from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens or token copies of Scute Swarm.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

2751-5657-5665.description:
Cast Spawn-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Ulalek and Spawn-Gang Commander trigger.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, then Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Once you have infinite {C} and Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to Spawn-Gang Commander to deal infinite damage to any target(s), and you may resolve all copies of the Spawn-Gang Commander spell.

401-4050-4336.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-4050-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {1}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3489-3542-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
3489-3542-5241.description:
Declare Sakashima's Student as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Sakashima's Student's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking as a copy of any nonlegendary creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

696-2645-2751-2872.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least seven charge counters on it.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
696-2645-2751-2872.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least seven {B}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

380-703-2047-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating eight token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger from step 2, creating four token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
